# Synthetic vision input

`synthetic-payment.png` is an invented English payment card rendered with Pillow and Arial. It contains no real personal or payment data and is not an export or screenshot from a payment platform. Its order total is CNY 35.00, its paid amount is CNY 28.50 and its displayed settlement date is 2026-11-06.

It checks the local-image-to-Codex interpretation path and distinguishing an order total from a paid amount. It does not establish WeChat Pay/Alipay format compatibility or real screenshot recognition accuracy. Real private-channel image receipt and owner verification remain deployment acceptance steps.
